conditional_modifications.description: Paths declared (write-conditional): edited only if a named gate fires. Outside the coverage denominator, inside the scope-creep allow set.

unplanned_changes.description: Paths of realized_files \ declared_files, recorded by the server with provenance when a task submit or a loop-back commit changed them; accepted and recorded, never reviewed and never blocking. Listed in the PR body and the landing record; for an epic plan an overlap with a sibling plan's declared surface is noted in the landing record only. Boundary breaches (outside the worktree, the main checkout, protected paths) are refused by the non-waivable guards and never recorded here.

task_id.description: provenance task: the task whose verified submit changed the path.

phase.description: The phase value of the phase sub-workflow on the call stack of the recording transition (store-schemas/03, Phases as Sub-Workflows).

state.description: measured: realized_files was captured from the plan's own worktree; unresolved: no worktree to measure (see cause); not_captured: no capture has been persisted (initial value, or the worktree is gone without a capture). Every consumer treats a state other than measured as indeterminate, never as clean.

cause.description: Set when state == unresolved: pending (worktree not yet materialised). Plans always execute in a worktree; there is no disabled cause.

files_total.description: The size of the plan's change at this capture (store-schemas/13, The Size of a Plan's Change); null unless state == measured.

captured_changes.description: Plans with a local_changes source only (land lane, phase-workflows.adoc): the change set of the main checkout captured once when the source was stored and kept as local-changes.json of the plan's source directory, copied here by the plan's creation transaction (the start.create-scope transaction of the plan bootstrap) and never re-captured; declared_files is the union of its paths and the paths changed by its commits_ahead. Null for every other plan.

snapshot_sha.description: The capture's snapshot commit: parent the main checkout's HEAD, tree its staged, unstaged, and untracked (not ignored) state; pinned by refs/pm-mcp/captures/<plan_id>, which is removed only after a merged landing and otherwise retained (owed item capture_ref_retained, removed by the operator's drop of the capture); the plan's branch starts at it (phase-workflows.adoc, Plan Source Contracts, local_changes).

base_ref.description: Base-branch commit the commits ahead were counted against.

porcelain.description: Two-character git status --porcelain code (dirty or staged).

digest.description: Blob SHA of the working-tree content, or 'deleted'.

commits_ahead.description: Commits of the main checkout's branch ahead of base_ref, oldest first.
